column1: # Curated FlorML region/island/province table -> GeoNames feature (or Wikidata-only / local-note).
# Built 2026-09-18 for the most frequent FlorML place mentions that place_aliases.tsv cannot resolve
# (Malesian regions/islands, Malaysian/Indonesian/Philippine states and islands, Gabon and Central
# African provinces). Keys are matched after flopo2.geo.gazetteer.normalize_name.
#   alias            the FlorML label form (normalised at lookup time)
#   kind             feature_type used on the Place (must be in flopo2.geo.vocab.FEATURE_TYPES)
#   geonames_id      GeoNames numeric id, seen in a fetched https://sws.geonames.org/<id>/about.rdf
#                    no personal identifier sent); blank when GeoNames has no matching feature
#   geonames_feature_code  gn:featureCode from that about.rdf (e.g. T.ISL, A.ADM1), for reference
#   wikidata_id      Wikidata QID, seen in a fetched wbsearchentities/EntityData response; blank
#                    unless GeoNames has no id (Malesia, New Britain cross-checked via P1566)
#   country_code     ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 the feature's own GeoNames record gives (gn:countryCode);
#                    blank when GeoNames gives none or the feature spans several countries
#   lat / lon        decimal degrees, from the same about.rdf/Wikidata P625 record
#   note             caveats, esp. where the match is approximate or historical/floristic-only
